definitions.explanation: The physical dimensions or resolution of a display screen on a device such as a television, computer monitor, smartphone, or tablet.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{画面|がめん}サイズ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧6.5インチだ。
examples.english: This smartphone has a 6.5-inch screen size.

examples.japanese: {画面|がめん}サイズ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{見|み}→見る：00283_miru⟧やすい。
examples.english: A larger screen size makes videos easier to watch.

examples.japanese: ⟦テレビ→テレビ：01536_terebi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{広|ひろ}さ→広さ：00105_hirosa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}った→合う：10466_au⟧{画面|がめん}サイズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: When buying a TV, it's important to choose a screen size that suits the room.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧ (screen/display) and ⟦サイズ→サイズ：01363_saizu⟧ (size, from English). A common term in electronics retail and product specifications.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画面|がめん}サイズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧: to choose a screen size
- {画面|がめん}サイズ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{変更|へんこう}する→変更する：30779_henkousuru⟧: to change the screen size
- ⟦{最大|さいだい}→最大：04827_saidai⟧{画面|がめん}サイズ: maximum screen size

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧: screen/display — the base word
- ⟦{解像度|かいぞうど}→解像度：04888_kaizoudo⟧: resolution — another key display specification
- {画素数|がそすう}: pixel count — related display metric
- {画面比率|がめんひりつ}: aspect ratio
